composition: Limestone stair down the west-coast cliff to a dark cove · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: 1000 Steps is the limestone stair on Bonaire's west-coast road, about sixty-seven steps built in the 1960s, not a thousand. The view looks down the cliff to a small rocky cove. It is mainly clear, about 28.3°C, with wind near 21.9 km/h and cloud cover about 23%. Night water is dark. No boat is shown. The church at Rincon is another scene and is not in this frame.
